description: This file defines the SecureStorageService class, a wrapper around the flutter_secure_storage package providing encrypted key-value storage for sensitive data such as PIN hashes or tokens in a Flutter application.

classes.name: SecureStorageService
classes.description: A service class that offers methods for securely writing, reading, and deleting data using platform-specific keystores.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores a sensitive value associated with a specific key securely.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves a securely stored value based on the provided key, returning null if the key does not exist.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes the key-value pair associated with the specified key from secure storage.
